data.name: Paper Arena Battle Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Every match writes its own story.
Paper Arena isn't a battle royale with a name-tag gimmick — it's a living battle simulator. Name your fighters, build them from scratch, or pull names straight from your own comment section. Then watch: AI combatants fight, flee, hunt, and hold grudges, carrying their history — wins, rivalries, titles — into every match after.

Key features:

  • Name and customize your own fighters — or import names from YouTube, Reddit, or your own community

  • Take direct control of one fighter, or watch the whole match unfold

  • Persistent records: rivalries, career stats, earned titles carry across matches

  • Emergent AI behavior — no two matches play the same

  • Built-in editors, free for everyone — build your own rosters, maps, and rulesets

  • Runs on modest hardware — no high-end rig required
